action: Data-centre operators and their customers in Malaysia: follow the Digital Infrastructure (Data Centres) Bill ahead of tabling in 2027 and map current security, disaster recovery and business continuity arrangements against an all-hazards standard. No action is required yet.
exec: Data centres in Malaysia are set to be regulated as critical national infrastructure, with new security and resilience duties.
plain: Malaysia's digital minister said a proposed law setting security, reliability and management rules for data centres is in final drafting and will go to parliament next year.

key_findings: In a written reply to Parliament dated November 12 the ministry said study of the draft Digital Infrastructure (Data Centres) Bill is in its final stages.
The bill is to be tabled in 2027 and would give a clearer framework for data-centre protection, operational resilience and governance.
It takes an all-hazards approach: cyber threats, system failures, operational disruption, natural disasters and physical and supply chain risks.
The ministry cites ICT and e-commerce at 23.5 per cent of GDP in 2025 and RM385.71 billion of approved digital investment from 2021 to June 2026.
recommendations: Once in force, data-centre operators would have to meet standards on security, resilience and operational continuity coordinated by the ministry.
Operators should expect requirements on preparedness, disaster recovery and business continuity.

summary: Malaysia's Digital Ministry said in a parliamentary written reply dated November 12 that study of the draft Digital Infrastructure (Data Centres) Bill is in its final stages and the bill will be tabled in 2027. The framework would take an all-hazards approach covering cyber threats, system failures, natural disasters and physical and supply chain risks, with standards on security, resilience, continuity and disaster recovery. No bill text is public.
title: Malaysia to table data-centre security bill next year

validation.note: Two national newspapers report the ministry's parliamentary written reply; the reply itself and any bill text were not available.

review.note: Written reply dated 12 Nov, final stages, 2027 tabling and all-hazards scope match The Star and NST (13 Nov).
